text: I've been waiting over an hour for a callback so I'll put it in writing. Granddaughter, 7. Temperature 38.2. She hasn't been to the toilet for a poo in three days and she is very grumpy about it, complaining her tummy feels full. She was sick once around teatime but she's kept all her drinks down since, little sips and then a full cup. Her colour is normal, lips and skin, I've checked. Breathing is normal, no puffing or anything. I just want to know if there's something I can give her for the constipation and whether the temperature needs anything more than what we're doing. Someone ring me back please.
